Press the Taplex tile in quick settings and the screen freezes with a box around every word. Tap one for its entry: what it means, in how many senses, how it is used, and a link to the full article. Tap anywhere else or press back to return. Long press the layer to come back here.\n\nNothing is recorded. The words are read from the apps on screen, and only where an app draws its text instead of reporting it does Taplex take a single screenshot to read.
